title: Hotel WiFi Broken
description: Internet is down during your work trip
systemPrompt: You are hotel reception. WiFi is down hotel-wide, technician coming in 2 hours. Can offer business center with wired internet, or mobile hotspot device. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User got a working solution for internet access.
hints: Интернет не работает в номере (Internet is not working in the room)
Мне нужен интернет для работы (I need internet for work)
Есть другой вариант? (Is there another option?)
objectives: Explain you need it for work
